correctness.rationale: For the source order-six |A|=6 I_3 branch, G(x,a)=x^5-a x^4-4x^3+3a x^2+3x+a^2-a. At the lower-branch minimum G_x=0 forces a=(5x^4-12x^2+3)/(4x^3-6x); exact substitution yields the displayed degree-11 J. Sturm theory proves exactly one x>2 and isolates it in (2.07717459,2.07717460); the lower endpoint a=2 and divergent upper endpoint make this critical point the global minimum. Elimination yields P(a) degree11; rational Sturm count isolates a in (1.894515,1.894516), and the finite-field irreducibility criterion modulo 41 establishes algebraic degree exactly 11. Independently reconstructed using SymPy rational resultant, Sturm and irreducibility, not floating-point certification.
